$comment: Machine-readable brand tokens. The prototype builder and scripts/brand_render.py read this. Keep in sync with visual-identity.md (brand_render.py check compares them).

colors.$comment: Hex, #RRGGBB. Images use background and text; the gradient phrase and the glow run primary into accent.

fonts.$comment: A Google Fonts family name (Inter), or a font file under brand/ (fonts/Heading.woff2).
fonts.heading: Space Grotesk

logo.$comment: Paths under brand/. The *_inverse files are for the opposite background (theme=inverse).
